---
title: DOCX cell probe
format: hebstr-doc-docx
---

Two `gt` sub-tables laid out side by side under one referenced float, a shape
that leaves a table cell open: knitr prints each table as a raw `{=openxml}`
block ending on `</w:tbl>`, and Quarto lays the sub-floats out in a
multi-cell table, which `docx-caption.lua` does not lift out.

```{r}
#| label: tbl-gt
#| tbl-cap: "Two gt tables as sub-floats."
#| tbl-subcap: ["Left", "Right"]
#| layout-ncol: 2
#| echo: false

gt::gt(head(mtcars[, 1:3], 3))
gt::gt(head(mtcars[, 4:6], 3))
```

Reference: @tbl-gt.
